contradictions.source: 戰死則無武故不資以妾
contradictions.english: Dying in battle means no martial pride, therefore they are not provided with a concubine.
contradictions.why: The source text says 'no martial [rites/honor]', but the translation interprets 'wu' as 'martial pride' and links it to the lack of concubines, which is a misreading of the classical context regarding burial rites.

contradictions.source: 胎者之屢無為愛之皆無
contradictions.english: Those who have a fetus are not unclear> repeatedly without purpose, for they all do not love it for
contradictions.why: The translation misinterprets the classical structure '胎者之屢' (the frequent/repeated nature of the fetus/womb) as 'those who have a fetus', changing the subject of the sentence.
